description: Fix live generation status: VisualPanel timer resumes from real job.createdAt (not 0s); Semakan Lepas shows 'Tengah jana' live via generation:start event + polling while any run is generating.

steps.name: diagnose (root cause)
steps.evidence: Timer: GET /api/jobs doesn't return createdAt so resume restarts at 0. Generating badge: history list only refetches on generation:complete (fires at finish) so the 'generating' window is never displayed — needs a generation:start event + poll-while-generating.

steps.name: build
steps.evidence: GET /api/jobs returns createdAt; VisualPanel startTimer(fromTs) + resume anchors to createdAt + dispatches generation:start; GenerationHistory listens generation:start + polls page 1 every 3s while any run generating

evidence.notes: poll resets to page 1 + brief loader flicker during generating window — transient, acceptable; poll self-terminates

steps.name: release-notes (CHANGELOG)
steps.evidence: CHANGELOG.md Fixed: timer resume + live Tengah jana badge
